metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Butt and Hip Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get instant relief for butt and hip pain. All of these exercises can be done at home and require no equipment. 

The exercises will focus on lengthening and strengthening the main muscles associated with hip pain, especially the glutes (aka buttocks), for both quick and long-lasting relief. 

Let us know what works best for you!
